access_links.label: Data Access Viewer (DAV) on the U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit
Tool or resource page named by the toolkit

description: Data Access Viewer (DAV) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Office for Coastal Management. Find available coastal data by drawing an area of interest on a map. The site will return links to LIDAR, imagery, land cover, and benthic data available for that location. Alternatively, choose a dataset of interest, and then make selections in an easy-to-use checkout interface to download your desired data. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
